character_vibe_description: Character & Vibe An honest snapshot - the energy, the people, the pace. The kind of thing no other directory tells you. Prabhadevi lives a double life. By day, the lanes around Siddhivinayak hum with devotees, flower-sellers and the steady ring of temple bells; by evening, the seafront towers glow and the area takes on the quiet confidence of one of Mumbai's most expensive addresses. Tuesdays bring huge crowds to the temple, while the rest of the week settles into an affluent, unhurried rhythm. It's a place where old Maharashtrian tradition meets new money - long-settled families and devout pilgrims alongside corporate leaders, celebrities and professionals in glass-fronted high-rises. Central, calm and connected, Prabhadevi carries a prestige few Mumbai neighbourhoods can match.

faq.question: What is Prabhadevi known for?
faq.answer: Prabhadevi is best known for the world-famous Shree Siddhivinayak Temple, one of Mumbai's most visited shrines. It is also an upscale residential and commercial locality between Dadar and Worli, home to the historic Prabhadevi (Sitladevi) Temple, Ravindra Natya Mandir and premium sea-facing high-rises.

faq.question: What is the pin code of Prabhadevi?
faq.answer: The primary pin code of Prabhadevi is 400025, with adjoining areas covered under 400028 (Dadar West side) and 400030 (Worli fringe).

faq.question: What are the sub-areas within Prabhadevi?
faq.answer: The main micro-localities within Prabhadevi are Siddhivinayak area, Century Bazaar, Sitladevi, Kohinoor Square, Adarsh Nagar, Cadell Road (Veer Savarkar Marg) and the Prabhadevi seafront.

faq.question: What is the property price in Prabhadevi?
faq.answer: Property prices in Prabhadevi are among the highest in Mumbai - ranging from ₹3.5–5 Cr for a 2BHK to ₹7–12 Cr for a 3BHK in premium sea-facing towers. Rental rates range from ₹75,000 to ₹3,00,000 per month depending on the building and view (as of May 2026).

faq.question: How to commute from Prabhadevi?
faq.answer: Prabhadevi is served by Western Railway's Prabhadevi Station (formerly Elphinstone Road, 12 min to Churchgate), the upcoming Metro Line 3, BEST bus routes 43, 84, 89, 171, and direct access to the Bandra-Worli Sea Link and the Coastal Road.

faq.question: Which hospitals are in Prabhadevi?
faq.answer: Major hospitals in and near Prabhadevi include Hinduja Healthcare, P. D. Hinduja Hospital (Mahim, nearby), Tata Memorial Hospital (Parel, nearby), Sushrut Hospital and several premium clinics along Veer Savarkar Marg.

faq.question: Which schools are in Prabhadevi?
faq.answer: Notable schools in and near Prabhadevi include St. Paul's High School, Shirodkar High School, Children's Academy, IES schools nearby in Dadar, and Podar institutions in Matunga.
